title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 068 ]

blocks.text: A terrible accident changed my life. A friend and I were driving home from a midnight movie. As we approached an intersection, we stopped at a red light. No cars seemed to be coming, so I decided to go through the red light. Immediately after we started, I lost consciousness. Later I learned that we had hit a car coming from the other direction. That accident made my friend spend the rest of his life in a wheelchair, and I learned a costly lesson.

readingSentences.english: A terrible accident changed my life.
readingSentences.korean: 한 끔찍한 사고가 내 인생을 바꾸어 놓았다.

readingSentences.english: A friend and I were driving home from a midnight movie.
readingSentences.korean: 한 친구와 나는 심야 영화를 보고 집으로 차를 몰고 가고 있었다.

readingSentences.english: As we approached an intersection, we stopped at a red light.
readingSentences.korean: 우리가 교차로에 다다랐을 때, 정지 신호를 보고 차를 멈추었다.

readingSentences.english: No cars seemed to be coming, so I decided to go through the red light.
readingSentences.korean: 어떤 차도 오지 않는 것 같아서, 나는 정지 신호를 무시하고 그냥 지나가기로 결정했다.

readingSentences.english: Immediately after we started, I lost consciousness.
readingSentences.korean: 우리가 출발한 직후 나는 의식을 잃었다.

readingSentences.english: Later I learned that we had hit a car coming from the other direction.
readingSentences.korean: 나중에야 나는 우리가 다른 방향에서 오고 있던 차와 충돌했다는 것을 알게 되었다.

readingSentences.english: That accident made my friend spend the rest of his life in a wheelchair, and I learned a costly lesson.
readingSentences.korean: 그 사고로 내 친구는 남은 평생을 휠체어에서 보내게 되었고, 나는 참으로 값비싼 교훈을 얻었다.
